_note: Proposed experiments. None start until the owner approves the change (it touches the live site). Baselines must be captured first.

experiments.problem: Visitors may not understand how the instant price is built (weight x rate + machine time), and the 'today only' discount label may reduce trust.
experiments.hypothesis: A visible worked example under the quote (grams x rate, minutes x rate, discount, shipping) increases quote-to-checkout rate.
experiments.change: Add an itemised price breakdown using real quote values; remove false urgency wording if the discount is ongoing.
experiments.baseline: Quote->checkout rate over 28 days (needs GA4 events confirmed)
experiments.secondary_kpi: WhatsApp pricing questions per week (manual count)
experiments.success_criteria: >=10% relative lift with >=100 quotes in each period
experiments.rollback: Revert the component (feature flag or previous build)

experiments.problem: Material guidance is a short homepage section; PLA/PETG/ABS availability conflicts.
experiments.hypothesis: A single, accurate material guide page (owner-verified) improves AI answers for material prompts and reduces wrong-material orders.
experiments.change: Publish verified comparison: uses, limits, price per gram, colours, availability.
experiments.benefit: Better-qualified orders, citations for material prompts
experiments.baseline: AI visibility for intent=materials prompts; GSC impressions for material queries
experiments.success_criteria: Citation in >=2 platforms where baseline had none; reported as directional (small sample)

experiments.problem: FAQ conflicts with pricing, refund policy and privacy on materials, cancellation and payment.
experiments.hypothesis: Resolving conflicts raises accuracy of AI answers about Mujassam.
experiments.change: Apply owner-confirmed facts across all pages.
experiments.benefit: Accurate AI descriptions; fewer support questions
experiments.baseline: Brand accuracy on brand prompts (eg-mujassam-what, en-mujassam-what)
experiments.success_criteria: 0 open conflicts; accuracy reviewed on all brand prompts

experiments.problem: No evidence-backed case studies (graduation projects, prototypes).
experiments.hypothesis: Two real, permissioned case studies with actual weight/time/material earn citations for use-case prompts.
experiments.change: Publish anonymised case studies from the knowledge base (publication_permission required).
experiments.success_criteria: Directional improvement on repeated samples; inconclusive if <10 observations
